symptom_short: zkCli shell dies with an unhandled NullPointerException when the node-status command is issued on a path that does not exist

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded; PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log.

ZOOKEEPER-1434 (zkCli NPE on `stat /non-existent`, affects 3.3.5) is Resolved/Won't Fix: Patrick Hunt declined a 3.3 backport because HBase depended on the 3.3 behaviour and the defect was ALREADY FIXED on trunk/3.4 by ZOOKEEPER-1059 (same symptom, same stack trace). The commit whose diff resolves the reported defect is therefore 7f64942ba (trunk, 2011-05-16, fixVersion 3.4.0): in ZooKeeperMain.processZKCmd the `stat` branch now null-checks zk.exists() and throws KeeperException.NoNodeException. pre_fix_commit=59ac9fa78 is the last commit where the bug exists (verified: the stat branch there calls printStat(zk.exists(...)) unguarded). The 3.3-branch patch attached to ZOOKEEPER-1434 itself (kept as private/jira-1434-attached-3.3-patch.diff) is the identical change, confirming the two tickets share one root cause.

Built the pre-fix tree (59ac9fa78, ZooKeeper 3.4.0-dev) from source with Ant+Ivy inside a per-bug image clods-eval:Zookeeper-Zookeeper-1434 (clods-eval + openjdk-8-jdk + ant; JDK11/17 refuse -target<7). Build cmd: 'ant jar' -> build/zookeeper-3.4.0.jar + build/classes + build/lib (slf4j 1.6.1, log4j 1.2.15, jline 0.9.94, netty 3.2.2.Final). Dep fixes (private/deps-fix.patch): (1) ivy.url repo2.maven.org -> https://repo1.maven.org (old host is gone / Central refuses plain HTTP); (2) ivysettings repo.maven.org/jboss/sun -> https://repo1.maven.org (jboss+download.java.net repos are dead); (3) javac.target 1.5 -> 1.8 (javac 8 defaults -source 1.8, which conflicts with -target 1.5). No source changes. BUILD SUCCESSFUL.

fix_commit_jira_ref: ZOOKEEPER-1059 (same defect; ZOOKEEPER-1434 is the 3.3.5 report, resolved Won't Fix for 3.3 because it was already fixed on trunk/3.4 by ZOOKEEPER-1059)
